g.text: Names in Pi versus names in Rholang: which arrows the two signatures actually contain
A Pi name can only ever be a VARIABLE — free, or bound
so the set of closed names is EMPTY and the two sorts
are disjoint. This is Milner's discipline exactly:
names are atoms, distinct from processes.
The two green arrows close a CYCLE, and that cycle is
the whole of reflection. The specification states the
